card.name: Dosing interval after "every"
card.fires_on: The word "every" or the space right after it, in dosing schedules, just before a number of weeks such as 2, 3, 4 or 6 weeks.

modes.label: Space after every
modes.description: The blank space token following "every", right before the number of weeks.
modes.example: on the same day every<< >>3 weeks for 4 doses, then

modes.label: The word every
modes.description: The word "every" itself after a dose amount in a schedule.
modes.example: 360 mg every 3 weeks with ipilimumab 1 mg/kg<< every>> 6 weeks In combination with ipil
